modules.name: Resident Approval
modules.description: Lets the Society Manager approve resident requests so residents get access to the app.

modules.name: Complaint Management
modules.description: Lets the Society Manager review complaints, mark them genuine and have them routed by category.

requirements.title: Pending list of requests and complaints
requirements.description: The Society Manager can open a pending list that shows resident requests and complaints.

requirements.title: Grant access and notify on resident approval
requirements.description: When the Society Manager approves a resident, the resident gets access and a notification.

requirements.title: Route genuine complaints by category
requirements.description: When the Society Manager marks a complaint genuine, the system routes the complaint by its category.

requirements.title: Reminder then escalation on no action
requirements.description: If the Society Manager takes no action in time, the system sends a reminder and then escalates to the Raghuvir Admin.

rules.title: Society Manager sees own project only
rules.description: The pending list shows requests and complaints of the Society Manager's own project only.
